name: slack_role_correction_status_check
branch: Pam's #it-access thread goes back and forth (edit first, then a correction to view only, with a colleague's tip in between); the agent reads the whole thread, finds her latest intent is viewer, and confirms from the access system that AR-103 is viewer and pending.
tests: Does the agent read the whole thread, work out that Pam's last word is view only, and confirm from get_approval_status that AR-103 is a pending viewer request?
instruction: You are Pam Beesly (employee ID E16). In #it-access you asked for the reporting dashboards (AR-103) and went back and forth in the thread about whether you needed to view or edit them. Ask the IT access desk to read your thread and confirm AR-103 is logged for what you settled on in the end. Do not say which role that was; if the desk asks, say it should match your last message in the thread (it was viewer).

persona.name: Pam Beesly
persona.initial_message: Hi IT access desk, I am Pam Beesly (E16). I went back and forth in my #it-access thread about the reporting dashboards (ts 1792764600.000004). Can you read it and confirm AR-103 is logged for what I settled on in the end?
